name: TileShift
description: Gen 3 world art for Gen 1/2, plus selectable monochrome Gen 1 and Crystal-based Gen 2 backgrounds in Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, FireRed and LeafGreen. Crystal-style Lavaridge, Mauville and Ever Grande are complete across Hoenn games. Gen 2 background refresh fixes overlapping original and replacement art after enabling or reloading. Right-facing side entrances, including Route 38, use the matching native threshold. Other Gen 3 areas remain partly converted. Original pixel scale, entrances, collision, actors, scripts and interactions are preserved.
